questions.prompt: Which Athenian statesman oversaw the building of the Parthenon?
questions.fact: He funded it partly from a defence league's treasury, which allies had contributed for warships rather than temples.

questions.prompt: Which organ system removes carbon dioxide from the blood?
questions.fact: The urge to breathe is triggered by rising carbon dioxide, not falling oxygen, which is why hyperventilating before a dive is dangerous.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2012 Summer Olympics?
questions.fact: It became the first city to host the modern Games three times.

questions.prompt: Which film features a character called Andy Dufresne?
questions.fact: It performed poorly in cinemas and became a favourite through television repeats and video rental.

questions.prompt: Which country has the world's longest single-country coastline on the Mediterranean?
questions.fact: Its thousands of islands mean the measured length far exceeds that of much larger mainland countries.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Emma and Persuasion?
questions.fact: Persuasion was published after her death, alongside a novel she had written more than fifteen years earlier.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym HTML5's canvas element enable?
questions.fact: It made browser games possible without plugins, which is much of why Flash disappeared.
